### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **24** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **9** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via meta.publishItem (sdk, the route ledger binds it to POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish, selected by route anchor /:type/:name/publish), publishItem (sdk, the bare tail of client method meta.publishItem, bound to POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish))_
- `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol PublishMetaItemResponseSchema — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol PublishMetaItemResponseSchema — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol PublishMetaItemResponseSchema — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol PublishMetaItemResponseSchema — its route source's handler names it))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol PublishMetaItemResponseSchema — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via publishPackageDrafts (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation), /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol PublishMetaItemResponseSchema — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-2.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol PublishMetaItemResponseSchema — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol PublishMetaItemResponseSchema — its route source's handler names it))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **9** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **175** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8fa738fbe370c6cd8742fa14857e1b82d9b5d2a4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `eed2f12ceb5527c9484871b0504ca576a8ea6673` — the merge of head `8dea3777a4a25877370951d5c2c7a70a0276a6aa` into base `8fa738fbe370c6cd8742fa14857e1b82d9b5d2a4`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin eed2f12ceb5527c9484871b0504ca576a8ea6673 && git checkout eed2f12ceb5527c9484871b0504ca576a8ea6673
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8fa738fbe370c6cd8742fa14857e1b82d9b5d2a4 8dea3777a4a25877370951d5c2c7a70a0276a6aa && git checkout -B drift-repro 8fa738fbe370c6cd8742fa14857e1b82d9b5d2a4 && git merge --no-ff 8dea3777a4a25877370951d5c2c7a70a0276a6aa

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8fa738fbe370c6cd8742fa14857e1b82d9b5d2a4
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8fa738fbe370c6cd8742fa14857e1b82d9b5d2a4` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c438aed4e40f67928b0fa4e0cb7b8cbaabc3c5a4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the PR diff against merge-base `fe835b49aa` (all 26 files; implementation `11b7c671` plus the merge of `origin/main`); `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` (`SEED_APPLIED_LANDED_IDS_CAP` :1422, `SeedAppliedIdListSchema` :1432-1442, `SeedAppliedLandedSchema` :1473-1484, the shared description :1488-1495, the docblock :1520-1531, the two `landed` keys :1590 and :1891); `packages/spec/src/data/seed-loader.zod.ts` (`landedIds` :441, `insertedIds` :459); `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` at head (`insertedRecordIndexes` :1336, `noteLanded` :1344-1355, the flush :1377-1468 with the mark at :1445, the sequential `writeRecord` path :2140-2185 with the mark at :2159, the catch :2171, the skip :2195, the update :2208, `landedIds` and `insertedIds` :2275-2289, `writeRecord` :3000-3062, `decideWriteAction` :3076-3105, `extractId` :3795-3798, `resolveDeferredUpdates`); `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-applied-landed.ts` (:30-36, :47-64); `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts` (`applySeedBodies` :70-186, `landed` :140, the catch :142-185); `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts` :374, :1100; `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` :12375, :12446; `packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts` :22; `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` (:2100, `applyPublishedSeeds` :3840-3985, `landed` :3983) and `packages/runtime/src/seed-loader.ts` (a re-export shim); `packages/objectql/src/publish-seed-receipt-landed-ids.test.ts` (8 cases :170-299); `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader-landed-ids.test.ts` (the #30348 describe :290-393, 6 cases); `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts` (:3034-3074, 4 cases); `packages/objectql/src/publish-meta-response-conformance.test.ts` :316-331; `packages/objectql/src/publish-package-drafts-seed-receipt-counts.test.ts` :197, :231; `packages/objectql/src/protocol-publish-package-drafts.test.ts` :422-424, :491 (mocked producer); the spec ledgers (`api-surface`, `authorable-surface/{api,data}.json`, `authorable-defaults/data.json`, `declaration-map`, `export-origins`, `json-schema.manifest`), `packages/spec/liveness/` (README, `seed.json`), the generated `content/docs/references/{api/protocol,data/seed-loader,index}.mdx`, the changeset; `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (:9-15, :907-943, :1594-1606, :2045-2049) and `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` (:111-121, :269-276); the seat order `/mnt/project-files/seat3-orders/30348.md`; card #30348 body and 5 comments (os-dev-report 6656124019 included); PR #30427 body, 2 comments, 0 reviews; check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Fidelity at every `noteLanded` site. There are five sites and two insert marks, and the marks sit exactly where a row is created: (a) the batched flush (:1442-1445) marks `recordIndex` beside `noteLanded` when `res.ok` and the stored id is non-empty; (b) the self-referencing sequential path (:2158-2159) marks only when `writeRecord` answered `action === 'inserted'`, and `writeRecord` (:3000-3062) answers that only after `engine.insert` returned, in every mode (`insert` :3012-3014, `upsert` miss :3037-3039, `ignore` miss :3046-3048, `replace` :3052-3054, the default arm :3057-3059); (c) the sequential catch (:2171) lands the pre-existing id of a refused UPDATE and marks nothing, and a refused INSERT has no `existingId` so it lands nowhere; (d) the skip site (:2195) lands the matched id for `ignore` and a no-op replay, marks nothing; (e) the update site (:2208) lands the matched id BEFORE the write and marks nothing, so a refused update is matched, as the body's table says. `decideWriteAction` (:3076-3105) routes a matched key in `ignore` to skip and in `upsert`/`update` to update or skip, and only an unmatched key (or any `insert`/`replace` record) reaches `pendingInserts`, so no customer row can enter the flush's `ok` branch except through the attempt-greater-than-one recheck (:1393-1400, :1430-1437), where a key hit is by construction a row this load's own earlier attempt wrote; that classification is right and is the same ambiguity the `inserted` counter already carried. Ids are the stored primary keys: `extractId` (:3795-3798) reads `record.id || record._id` off the engine's returned row or the loaded existing row, and the re-identification map (#21665) is fed from the same `landedId`. Dedupe and order: `insertedIds` (:2284-2289) is the same `internalIdByRecordIndex` map as `landedIds` (:2275-2279), filtered by the mark set, sorted by record index, then `Set`-deduped, so `insertedIds` is a subset of `landedIds` by construction. Pass 2 (`resolveDeferredUpdates`) touches only `referencesResolved` and the error list on `allResults`, never the id lists, and pushes no result. A dry run never calls `noteLanded` (:2241-2247), so both lists are empty. The projection (`seed-applied-landed.ts` :47-64) folds per object in first-loaded order, unions `insertedIds` and `landedIds` over the object's datasets, and derives `matched` as `landed minus inserted` (:61), so a second dataset's key hit on a row the first dataset created stays `inserted`; the objectql pin at :242 measures that against the engine. A result lacking `insertedIds` (an older loader shape) puts everything under `matched`, the safe direction.
2. Cap boundary. `cappedList` (:30-36): `ids.slice(0, 200)`, `total: ids.length`, `truncated: ids.length > 200`, so exactly 200 ids give `truncated: false, total: 200` and 201 give 200 ids, `truncated: true, total: 201`. The schema (:1433) refuses a 201st id; the spec pin at :3061 parses 200 and refuses 201, and the objectql pin at :216 drives 205 records through the real door and asserts the first 200 in record order, `total: 205`, `truncated: true`, then shows the schema refusing the uncut list. The exactly-200 boundary is pinned at the schema only, not through the projection (judgment 5).
3. Both doors and the fallback. `applySeedBodies` returns `landed: seedAppliedLanded(r.results)` only on the returned-load path (:140); the catch (:142-185) returns counts from `seedLoadPartialWrites` with no `landed`, pinned at :273 (a good seed lands, a missing-object seed throws, `inserted: 1`, no `landed` key). `publishPackageDrafts` passes the whole object through (`protocol.ts` :12375, :12446); `publishMetaItem` goes through `runPublishSideEffects` (`protocol-history-and-publish.ts` :1100) and copies the object whole (:374); neither picks fields, and both are driven by real-door pins (:170 and :289). The runtime fallback (`packages.ts` :3983) imports the same projection through `index.ts` :22 and its loader is the same class (`packages/runtime/src/seed-loader.ts` re-exports `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s `SeedLoaderService`; `git grep "class SeedLoaderService"` finds one), so `insertedIds` is filled there too. The fallback's `landed` has no door pin of its own; its producer is a one-line fold of the same function, acceptable by reading.
4. Declarations. PR body and changeset both carry `Clause-②: yes (widening: …)` (arm `widening`, the first token inside the parenthesis, `clause2-line.mjs` :269) and `Metadata-protocol: added`. `added` is the grade the checker owes: `authorable-surface/api.json` (six `SeedAppliedIdList`/`SeedAppliedLanded` keys), `authorable-surface/data.json` (`SeedLoadResult:insertedIds`) and `authorable-defaults/data.json` (`insertedIds = []`) all moved, and a moved baseline under `none` is refused (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs` :1594-1606); the changeset grades spec `minor`, metadata-protocol `minor` (a new exported symbol `seedAppliedLanded` and a new receipt key), runtime `patch`. `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Spec property liveness` are green on the head. Liveness: the ledger governs registered metadata types (`liveness/README.md`, `seed.json` holds `Seed`'s authorable keys); neither `SeedLoadResult` nor the publish responses have rows, `landedIds` has none, so `insertedIds` and `landed` owe none, and the PR claims none. Honest.
5. Pins and ablation. Every claim in the order has a pin: exact ids per object at the real door (:170), the over-cap shape (:216), no seed means no field (:260), existing receipts parse unchanged and gain no key (:3050), one shared schema on both responses (:3043, and the real-door parses at :182 and :298), required `total`/`truncated`/both lists (:3069), and the loader split per mode (fresh, replay, `ignore` over a customer row, refused update, self-referencing path, refused insert and dry run, :290-393). Ablation 1 (the flush mark deleted) reddens 3 of 14 loader cases and ablation 2 (the `matched` filter neutralised in dist) reddens 6 of 8 door cases, both real reds and both reported with blob hashes and restoration. Gaps: no unit pin on `seedAppliedLanded` itself (junk entries at :50 are tolerated by reading only: `null`, non-string `object`, a result with neither list; exactly 200 through `cappedList`; empty `results` giving `[]`), no empty-seed door pin (`records: []` giving one entry with two empty lists, which the docblock at :41-45 and the description at :1491 promise), and the fallback producer is unpinned. The two unchanged `toEqual` pins in `protocol-publish-package-drafts.test.ts` (:440, :502) mock `applySeedBodies` (:422-424, :491), so they are correct as left; the two real-loader pins the dev did update (:197, :231) admit `landed` with `expect.any(Array)` and defer the ids to the new file.
6. Backward compatibility. `landed` is optional on both schemas; a receipt without it parses byte-identically (:3050-3058). The inline TS return types gain an optional key only. `SeedLoadResultSchema.insertedIds` defaults to `[]` like `landedIds`, so an old-shaped result parses; a reader of `landedIds` alone (`seed-settlement.ts` :50-96, `claim-seed-ownership.ts`, `app-plugin.ts` :2022-2051) is untouched. Readers of the old receipt see one extra key.
7. Body versus code. The two insert sites, the merge/dedupe/cap rules, the per-mode table, the thrown-load omission, the cap source and the test counts (8, +6, +4) all match the code. The body says the `inserted` list is "in record order" while the schema description (:1434) says "first-landed first"; the loader sorts by record index (:2277, :2287), and a matched row at a later index lands in wall time before a buffered insert at an earlier index flushes, so the schema wording is the looser of the two (judgment ④.3).

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor, `@objectstack/runtime` patch. Two new exported schemas, one constant, one optional key on two published response schemas and one defaulted key on `SeedLoadResult`; one new exported function from metadata-protocol. Nothing refused, narrowed or re-meant. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added` are the right pair for what the checker measures.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Files touched stay inside the order: the two spec files, the loader's two insert sites, one new projection module beside `applySeedBodies`, the two doors' return types, the runtime fallback (named in the order's "every producer of it, any other route that attaches `seedApplied`" clause and the third claim's "the publish paths that return `seedApplied`"), their tests, and regenerated artifacts. `seed-settlement.ts` and the cloud half are untouched. `app-plugin.ts`'s boot-time landed computation (:2022-2051) is the boot source the order excludes and is untouched.
- The cap's source: cloud was unreadable from the dev session (the body says so, with a 0-hit org search), and the order's third rung ("pick a cap, give the reason, and stop to tell the seat") was followed: the seat chose 200 with the dev before the build, mirroring `EXPLAIN_BATCH_MAX_RECORD_IDS` and `BULK_BATCH_SIZE`. One constant to move if cloud's ledger cap differs.
- Carried tier: (a) a load that throws mid-batch drops the ids of the datasets that landed before it (`SeedLoadPartialWrites` carries counts only, :165-169); the receipt says "not reported" and cloud must read absent `landed` beside `success: false` as unknown, as the body states; widening `SeedLoadPartialWrites` is a follow-up card. (b) `claim-seed-ownership.ts` and `seed-settlement.ts` read `landedIds` only and so hand over matched rows too; whether the ownership claim should narrow to `insertedIds` is a separate ruling, not this card.
- No governed surface in the file list; no release-owned page edited; the docs-drift bot's five hand-written pages name the route, not the key.

### ④ Design judgment

The split into `inserted` and `matched` is the right shape and the only safe one under the `ignore` default: a single landed list would have handed cloud's "clear sample data" a customer's row. The projection lives in metadata-protocol once and both producers import it, the cap and the truncation shape are declared in the spec and refused by the schema past the cap, and every claim in the order is pinned at a real door against the engine. Must-fix: none. Should-fix, in order: (1) add `seed-applied-landed.test.ts` with direct pins on the projection: junk entries (`null`, non-string `object`, a result with neither list, a result with `landedIds` only), empty `results` giving `[]`, exactly 200 ids giving `truncated: false` and 201 giving `truncated: true, total: 201`, and the cross-dataset inserted-then-matched fold without the engine; (2) add an empty-seed door pin (`records: []`) asserting one entry with two empty lists, since the docblock and the description both promise it; (3) align `SeedAppliedIdListSchema.ids`'s "first-landed first" (:1434) with the loader's "record order" (:2277, :2287) so the two docs say the same thing; (4) file the thrown-load follow-up (ids of datasets landed before the throw) as its own card so cloud's reading of absent `landed` has a named end. None blocks landing; landing waits on the still-running required contexts (`Build Core`, `Test Core` 1-8, `Type Check`, `Lint`) going green.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 发布回执的 `seedApplied` 新增可选键 `landed`：按对象列出本次种子落地的行 id，分成 `inserted`（本次新建的行）和 `matched`（种子按键命中的已有行），每个列表最多 200 个 id，超出时标 `truncated` 并给出总数。种子加载器的每数据集结果新增 `insertedIds`。
- **为什么改：** cloud 的「清除示例数据」要知道种子建了哪些行。只给一个 landed 列表不安全：默认 `ignore` 模式下，命中键的客户自有行也会算进去，清除时会删掉客户数据。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯新增可选键，旧回执照常解析。两个发布入口和运行时兜底路径共用同一个投影函数。加载中途抛错时回执不带 `landed`（表示「未报告」，不是「没有落地」），已另开卡 #30429。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`（`SEED_APPLIED_LANDED_IDS_CAP`、`SeedAppliedLandedSchema`）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-applied-landed.ts`；`seed-loader.ts` 的两处插入标记。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/seed-applied-landed.test.ts`，预期 9 passed。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：fable 契约复审 PASS，没有必须修的。前三条建议已在一次推送里采纳：投影函数的 9 个直接钉（含 200/201 边界）、空种子的入口钉、id 顺序的措辞改为加载器的记录顺序。第四条（中途抛错时丢失已落地 id）另开 #30429。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:spec#3 · head `8dea3777a4a25877370951d5c2c7a70a0276a6aa`

- **Shape:** 27 files (+951 −20, generated ledgers and docs included) on `origin/main` `fe835b49`:
  - `@objectstack/spec`: `SEED_APPLIED_LANDED_IDS_CAP` (200), `SeedAppliedIdListSchema` `{ ids, total, truncated }`, `SeedAppliedLandedSchema` per object `{ object, inserted, matched }`, an optional `landed` on both `seedApplied` receipts, and `SeedLoadResult.insertedIds`;
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: the loader marks a row inserted at its two insert sites (the batched flush and the sequential `writeRecord` path), one exported projection `seedAppliedLanded`, and `applySeedBodies` returns `landed`, so `publishPackageDrafts` and `publishMetaItem` carry it;
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: the package-publish fallback seed apply reports the same `landed` through the same projection;
  - pins, regenerated ledgers and docs, a changeset (spec minor, metadata-protocol minor, runtime patch).
- **Premise measured:** at `origin/main`, the receipt carried counts only, and `SeedLoadResult.landedIds` mixed inserted and matched rows (the card's measurement).
- **Gates:** at `8dea3777` after a full build (119/119), 107 derived gates run, all exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles with 0 NOT-MEASURED (dev report). Check-runs on this head: 57 success, 10 skipped, 0 red; `Check Changeset` and the PR-body guards re-run after the seat's body edit.
- **Contract review:**
  - Full review, 6656296448 on `c438aed4`: PASS, no must-fix.
